tasks.label: Create rules file using workspace path
tasks.command:
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Set-Content -Path '.github/agent/rules.md' -Value @'
---
# Shared agent rules for repository-scoped agents
rules:
  - id: no_commandline_search
    summary: "Do not search the workspace using command-line tools."
    detail: |
      Agents must not execute shell commands like `grep`, `find`, `rg`, or `ls` to search repository files.
      Use the `repo_browser` or `code_search` tools to find files and contents instead.
  - id: use_search_tools
    summary: "Use dedicated search tools for code discovery."
    detail: |
      Use `code_search` or `repo_browser` to locate files and cite paths/line ranges.
  - id: no_unrestricted_shell
    summary: "Avoid running unrestricted shell commands."
    detail: |
      The `shell` tool is restricted; only run commands when explicitly allowed by maintainers.
  - id: minimal_changes
    summary: "Prefer minimal, style-consistent edits."
    detail: |
      Provide small, well-tested changes matching repository style. Include tests and run instructions.
  - id: no_secrets
    summary: "Never expose secrets or credentials."
    detail: |
      Do not read, include, or store any secrets; redact or refuse if necessary.
  - id: verify_with_tests
    summary: "Include/Update tests for non-trivial changes."
    detail: |
      Add or update tests and include commands to run them locally.
---
'@ -Encoding UTF8"

tasks.label: write-my-agent
tasks.command:
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Set-Content -Path '.github/agents/my-agent.agent.md' -Value @'
---
name: my-agent
display_name: my-agent
description: "Worker agent — performs edits on explicit user requests; asks only when multiple choices exist."
models:
  - name: gpt-5-mini
    type: llm
tools:
  - repo_browser
  - editor
  - git
prompts:
  system: |
    You are the repository worker agent. When the user explicitly requests you to read, create, or edit files in this workspace, proceed immediately and perform the requested operations without asking for approval or confirmation.
    Only ask the user for clarification or explicit confirmation if the task has multiple clearly different reasonable options that require weighing trade-offs, or if the requested change is destructive or security-sensitive.
    Do not emit a preamble before actions. After completing actions, provide a concise summary of what you changed and why (2–3 sentences), and list files modified.
    Always follow repository rules in `.github/agent-rules.md` (no command-line searching, no secrets, prefer minimal changes, add tests).
  user: |
    Perform the requested task. If multiple approaches exist, list them concisely and wait for selection; otherwise act and report changes.
---
'@ -Encoding UTF8"
